description: This donut chart, a variation of a pie chart, displays the distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs. The chart is divided into 10 distinct slices separated by thin white borders, with the bolded text "Stimulus Type" positioned in the central empty space. There is no separate legend; instead, each category label and its exact percentage enclosed in parentheses are positioned outside the ring, directly adjacent to their respective slices. Reading clockwise starting from the top right, the segments include "Draft/Other" in dark red (26.4%), "Event Posting" in dark brown (6.6%), "Organizational Report" in muted purple (7.7%), "Organizational Website" in light purple (4.9%), "Interview" in dark navy blue (8.8%), "Intra-agency news article" in medium blue (4.9%), "External News Article" in dark green (18.1%), "Email" in light green (2.7%), "Press Release" in gold (18.7%), and "Social Media Post" in orange (1.1%). The slices do not follow a specific ascending or descending size order, and no individual segments are visually exploded or offset from the main ring.
